brief: Create a responsive booking experience for Stillwater Rooms, a fictional neighborhood wellness studio. A visitor must be able to choose a room, date, time, party size, enter contact details, review the reservation, and reach an on-page confirmation.
deterministic_acceptance: A new booking can be completed from room selection through confirmation using keyboard input.
Dates outside the next 14 days, party sizes above room capacity, absent name, and invalid email are blocked with field-associated messages.
Back navigation preserves entered values and changing room invalidates an incompatible party size.
Review shows the selected room, date, time, party size, name, and email before submission.
Submission displays confirmation code SW-2048 without a network dependency and supports starting over.
At 390x844 and 1440x900 there is no horizontal document overflow and the current step is announced.
